summary: DOSM occupation categories combine digital games with esports, and the inspected MDEC Southeast Asia studies report studio/respondent samples and salary distributions. No defensible national domestic development/publishing employment stock was verified; regional sample sizes are not country workforce totals.

sources.title: Southeast Asia Game Talent Economics Report 2024
sources.locator: PDF p 24 survey scope; Malaysia chapter pp 48–60; p 37 freelance/company-size comparison
sources.notes: 295 individual respondents and 48 studios across six countries. Country salary breakdowns are sample-based; no national worker total extracted.

sources.title: Southeast Asia Game Industry Report 2021
sources.notes: Regional studio survey; foreign ownership means company ownership, not employee citizenship. External development/work-for-hire share refers to studio business activity, not freelancer headcount.

limitations: Evidence gap after all three search routes; no placeholder zero.
Regional studio and talent samples are not population estimates.
Business ownership and outsourcing revenue/work shares must not be labelled foreign-worker or contractor shares.
No verified nationality or contractor percentage for Malaysian national games workforce.
review_checks: Read survey denominator, studio-size and freelance salary comparisons in primary MDEC PDFs.
No employment count created from salary samples or company-size bins.
